title: Criterion
body: The id of one acceptance criterion in its owning issue body.

title: Theme Board Title
body: A proposal-derived board title is the originating proposal's exact `[Pxx]` designator, a space, the theme name, a colon, and its description: `[P03] Canon: Definitions Checked Against the Design Canon`. Preserve the proposal's digits exactly. A board with no originating proposal uses `Name: Description`.

title: Labels
body:
The collection of repository label names attached to the issue.

The collection includes `enhancement`, `bug` and `tech-debt` as applicable; every name identifies an existing repository label. eg `workflows` for workflow-server.

title: Assignment Read Result
body: One JSON object with `assignments`, the complete body-wide [Assignments](#assignments) map, and `problems`, an array of finding strings. An empty array means no findings. eg `{"assignments":{"W01":"02","W02":null},"problems":[]}`

title: Unit Lane Result
body: One JSON object containing the members of [Assignment Read Result](#assignment-read-result), plus `lane`, the selected unit's common [Index](#index) or `null`. Null represents an unlaned unit or an invalid or undetermined unit; `problems` distinguishes them. eg `{"assignments":{"W01":"02","W02":null},"problems":[],"lane":"02"}`

title: Admission Result
body: One JSON object containing the members of [Unit Lane Result](#unit-lane-result), plus `admitted`, a boolean indicating whether the selected unit is valid and the request admits it. The shared members remain at the top level. Findings can concern rows outside the selected unit. eg `{"assignments":{"W01":"02","W02":null},"problems":[],"lane":"02","admitted":true}`
